title: Number of Atoms
description: Parse a chemical formula string and return the count of each atom in a lexicographically sorted map.
pseudocode:
1. stack = [Map()]
2. for i = 0 to length - 1:
3.   if char is '(': stack.push(Map())
4.   else if char is ')': pop top map, multiply counts by number, merge into new top
5.   else if char is uppercase: parse atom name and count, update top map
6. return sorted keys and counts

steps.note: Initialize empty stack with a base map.
Pushed new map for parentheses scope.
Multiply counts inside by 2 and merge into outer map.
